description: Catholic University of Louvain: inland waterway datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catholic University of Louvain. Coverage: Catholic University of Louvain. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about inland waterway; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Mise en œuvre d’une recherche de fond dans le canal d’énergie multifon; Réexécution d'une recherche de staus dans le canal ditau + MET (139 fb; Mise en œuvre d'une recherche de matière noire dans le canal monojet (; Mise en œuvre d'une recherche de leptoquarks dans le canal électron(s). Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
